rdf:Description.skos:prefLabel: Refactor Identifier Cleaning Functions from draw_io_parser.py
rdf:Description.skos:description: This ticket covers the refactoring of the identifier cleaning functions from `draw_io_parser.py`. These functions are responsible for cleaning up node labels to create valid IRIs and should be moved to the new `DrawIOParser` class and made more configurable.
rdf:Description.skos:scopeNote:
**Relevant Code Snippets:** ```python def _handle_spaces( identifier: str, space_substitute: Replacement, capitalisation_scheme: str) -> str: # ...
def _replace_metacharacter( metacharacter: str, identifier: str, metacharacter_substitutes: list[ tuple[Metacharacter, Replacement]]) -> str: # ...
def _replace_metacharacters( identifier: str, metacharacter_substitutes: list[tuple[Metacharacter, Replacement]], space_substitute: Replacement | None, capitalisation_scheme: str) -> str: # ... ```
rdf:Description.skos:changeNote: **Implementation Plan:** 1. **Move Functions to `DrawIOParser` as Private Methods:** - Move the logic from `_handle_spaces`, `_replace_metacharacter`, and `_replace_metacharacters` into private methods of the `DrawIOParser` class (e.g., `_clean_identifier`). 2. **Make them Configurable:** - The behavior of these methods (e.g., the space substitute, the capitalisation scheme, the metacharacter substitutes) will be controlled by the `DrawIOParserConfig` object passed to the `DrawIOParser`. 3. **Update `DrawIOParser`:** - The `_parse_individual` method of the `DrawIOParser` will call the new `_clean_identifier` method to process the identifier from the Draw.io node.
